1479-2841-3585-8106.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Myriad Landscape.
There are two basic land cards in your library that share a basic land type.
1479-2841-3585-8106.description:
Fetch a land using Myriad Landscape.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-5223-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

215-850-4460.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with defender.
215-850-4460.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Overgrown Battlement from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Overgrown Battlement by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6156-7705.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-7705.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-3478-7705.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Mole Man, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Mole Man trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2292-3175-5617.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

6255-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
6255-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Zahur and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1617-4831-4983-5358-5726.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
You have enough mana to cast Three Steps Ahead.
1617-4831-4983-5358-5726.description:
Cast Three Steps Ahead by paying {U} plus {3} to choose its second mode, creating a token copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and the nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur each trigger twice.
Resolve all Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having the token and nontoken Bellowing Aegisaur fight Cacophodon.
1617-4831-4983-5358-5726.notes: Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters, you may instead have Cacophodon fight another creature you control.

4629-7283.description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and player.
Raphael triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1308-2653-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1308-2653-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating two Mutavault land tokens that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve the Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

38-5220-5933-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4063-4905-5220-6900.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1271-1621-4605-5848.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that can attack this turn.
1271-1621-4605-5848.description:
Activate Scroll Rack by paying {1} and tapping it, exiling Wispweaver Angel from your hand face down, then putting the top card of your library into your hand and putting Wispweaver Angel onto the top of your library.
Declare Arthur and another creature as attackers, triggering Arthur, looking at the top six cards of your library and putting Wispweaver Angel onto the battlefield tapped and attacking. 
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Wispweaver Angel that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 3.

1062-3484-5636-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3484-5636-5674.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

2146-2421-3705-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

225-5226-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
225-5226-5531-6621.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-5226-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining triggers.
Repeat from step 1.

224-573-1772-2653.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Nissa trigger
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1445-2267-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4871-5231.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1003-1329-2178-2981.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-2981.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

428-804-1694-2770.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
You have enough mana to cast Donate.
428-804-1694-2770.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima the Impostor.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

2609-4050-5851.manaNeeded: {9}{W} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters you control
2609-4050-5851.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Recruit the Worthy, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {W}.
If you control at least 6 Stormsplitters, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Stormsplitter tokens, adding {3}.
Repeat.

4067-4395-5806.notablePrerequisites:
Thieving Otter does not have summoning sickness.
Lightning Prowess attached to Thieving Otter.
4067-4395-5806.description:
Activate Thieving Otter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Thieving Otter triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Thieving Otter.
Repeat.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-4089--39.notablePrerequisites: Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-4089--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

1069-1374-1879-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-1879-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

891-1585-2523-5147.easyPrerequisites: In Bolas's Clutches attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-1585-2523-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies as a legendary creature due to In Bolas's Clutches, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Boonweaver Giant that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
When the Boonweaver Giant token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning In Bolas's Clutches from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

917-4067-4435.notablePrerequisites:
You have no cards in hand.
You control a mana-producing permanent.
917-4067-4435.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Idle Thoughts by paying {2}, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana producing permanent.
Repeat.

1849-2232-3198-4050-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods by paying {6}{G}{G}, creating six 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
The Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio six times.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Lore Drakkis from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve all remaining Cloudstone Curio triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Activate all Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding six {G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Forest Dryads, adding {2}{U/R}{U/R}.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, mutating it on top of a Forest Dryad.
Lore Drakkis triggers, returning Awaken the Woods from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2397-3484-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
2397-3484-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Decoction Module twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

147-2292-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities from step 5.
